description: This Java class defines a DynamicViewEntity used for declaring dynamic view entities in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for constructing XML representations of view entities, managing entity aliases, view links, relations, and other metadata related to dynamic views.

classes.name: DynamicViewEntity
classes.description: Represents a dynamic view entity in OFBiz, allowing for flexible construction of view definitions including aliases, links, and relations.

methods.name: makeModelViewEntity
methods.description: Creates a ModelViewEntity object based on this DynamicViewEntity and a given Delegator.

methods.name: getViewXml
methods.description: Generates an XML string representation of the view entity for a specified entity name.

methods.name: getViewElement
methods.description: Constructs an XML element representing the view entity, including members, aliases, links, and relations.

methods.name: getOneRealEntityName
methods.description: Returns the first entity name from the member entities, or null if none exist.

methods.name: addMemberEntity
methods.description: Adds a member entity alias and name to the view.

methods.name: addAliasAll
methods.description: Adds an alias-all configuration for an entity with optional prefix and excludes.

methods.name: addAllAliasAllsToList
methods.description: Adds all alias-all configurations to a provided list.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Adds an alias with various optional parameters such as field, colAlias, primKey, groupBy, function, and complexAliasMember.

methods.name: addAllAliasesToList
methods.description: Adds all defined aliases to a provided list.

methods.name: addViewLink
methods.description: Defines a view link (join) between entities with optional rel-entity and key mappings.

methods.name: addAllViewLinksToList
methods.description: Adds all view links to a provided list.

methods.name: addRelation
methods.description: Defines a relationship between this entity and another, specifying type, title, related entity, and key mappings.

methods.name: addAllRelationsToList
methods.description: Adds all relations to a provided list.

methods.name: setGroupBy
methods.description: Sets the list of fields to group by in the view.

methods.name: addAllGroupByFieldsToList
methods.description: Adds the group's by fields to a provided list.
